resources.string: I stride into the storm so my allies never have to.
Swift as lightning, my spear finds the future first.
When hope falters, my hands stitch the world anew.
From velvet night I rise, hunger honed by ambition.
I anchor the line; break on me and break for good.
Today I learn the rules; tomorrow I\'ll rewrite them.
A sworn blade in silence; duty first, glory after.
